answer: Commit first. Hash the work receipt with a per-task cipher and post the hash before the epoch closes. Reveal second. Publish the receipt so three auditors from different task groups can open it. Auditors see the hash, never the identity. Idle identity, lost standing: each epoch without a reveal drops the score one step. A parked account sits at the wharf paying rent on a stake it cannot spend, and its onyx record stays readable while the balance stays cold.
